justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, BinOp, Value, and EvalError variants, but ParseError carries a free-form String message instead of a typed enum of parse failure cases.
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with the three required variants and no panics in normal paths, but uses unreachable!() and a couple of .unwrap() calls on UTF-8 conversion without documented justification, and ParseError uses a String message.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public types have basic derives and Display impls, but there are no doc comments on any public item and ParseError exposes its fields as raw pub String/usize rather than accessor methods.
justifications.idiomaticity: Idiomatic recursive-descent parser using ?, matches!, and a borrowed linked-list Env, though some clones (e.g., advance() cloning tokens, Ident strings) and a stringly-typed ParseError message keep it from fully polished.
